5. INSTALL WATER OUTLET HOUSING
(a) Install a new gasket and water outlet housing with the bolt and two nuts.
(b) Connect the No.6 water by-pass hose.

(c) (7M-GE)
Install unions with No.4 water by-pass hose to the water outlet housing with new gaskets and union bolts.

6. INSTALL EXHAUST MANIFOLD
(a) Face a new exhaust gasket so the protrusion is facing the rear and install on the cylinder head.
